thread:
kari: Proposal: migrate to route-scoped SAs to enforce per-route quotas. Biggest asks: clear billing rule, safe console rollout, and telemetry to explain denies.

nate: Don't break project keys. Keep legacy keys for billing but emit exchange events so we can show migration delta.

olga-ui: Console idea: single "Auth migration" card with status pill + small table: origin_key, effective_sa, route, tokens. Add canary slider (0-100%).

kari: Billing rule: default to bill-to-origin_key; add org flag "bill_by_effective" for customers who want billing to follow SAs. Off by default.

ryan: Telemetry: sample at gateway pre-exchange, record origin_key, then enrich after exchange with sa_id. Query to power card:
SELECT origin_key, sa_id, route, sum(tokens) FROM telemetry.sampled GROUP BY 1,2,3;

nate: Safety net: if enabling enforcement would bump deny-rate >0.5% of org traffic auto-decrease canary and alert owner.

quota-bot: ALERT: staging saw +12% quota-denies on /v1/embeddings since 1795551200. sample_ids:["s-a1","s-b2"].

kari: Action items: 
- Ryan: implement pre-exchange sampling + ExchangeEvent (eng-runtime)
- Olga: mockups and copy (devex)
- Nate: add safety-net auto-rollback rule (eng-platform)

kari: Sync Thurs 9am to review first telemetry and mockups. :thumbsup:
